title: Role-play lab: five overlap conversations
objectives: Answer five overlap conversations using tools, costs and client approval.
Use the module's scenario answers (Q21–Q25) as trainer-marked practice.
body_md:
In pairs. One person plays the client, the other explains — in plain words, with a rupee example. Scenarios: Suresh has 14 equity funds with ₹1,000 SIPs each. Divya holds three large-cap funds from different AMCs “for safety”. A client wants to add last year's top flexi-cap fund. Kiran holds many employer shares via ESOPs, and his funds also hold that stock. A client receives a notice that a thematic fund is being merged.

> **Investor takeaway:** Quiz scenarios Q21–Q25 (trainer-marked): a scenario answer earns its mark if it covers at least three model points and makes no promise of returns.
example: Role-play Suresh: check overlap, propose 4–5 core-satellite funds, redirect SIPs first, check loads and tax, record approval.
say: Check overlap, costs and goals, then decide with approval.
Record reasons for every fund kept or dropped.
never: Add funds without checking what the portfolio already holds.
Switch funds mainly to earn commission.

check.q: Suresh has 14 equity funds with ₹1,000 SIPs each. What do you propose?
o: Check overlap; propose a core-satellite structure of 4–5 funds; redirect SIPs first; check exit loads and tax before any redemption; record his approval
check.why: Check overlap; propose a core-satellite structure of 4–5 funds; redirect SIPs first; check exit loads and tax before any redemption; record his approval.

check.q: Divya holds three large-cap funds from different AMCs “for safety”. What do you explain?
o: Agree — different AMCs are always safer
Show their high overlap; explain safety comes from what is owned, not the number of AMCs; suggest keeping one core fund
Switch everything to a single AMC for safety
check.why: Show their high overlap; explain safety comes from what is owned, not the number of AMCs; suggest keeping one core fund.

check.q: A client wants to add last year's top flexi-cap fund. What do you do first?
o: Check its overlap with existing funds; ask what job it would do; add only if it brings something different
Replace all existing funds with it
Ignore overlap and follow the rating
check.why: Check its overlap with existing funds; ask what job it would do; add only if it brings something different.
